title: Congress workers in Palakkad send gooseberries to Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan in protest

ai.summary: Congress workers in Palakkad sent gooseberries to Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan as a protest against his remarks criticizing Vadakara MP Shafi Parambil, claiming his support had unsettled him.

facts.claim: Congress workers staged a novel protest against Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan
facts.quote: Congress workers here staged a novel protest against Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan, over his controversial remarks against Vadakara MP Shafi Parambil.

facts.claim: A group of Congress workers at Vandazhi sent a parcel of gooseberries (nellikka) to Mr. Unnithan
facts.quote: A group of Congress workers at Vandazhi sent a parcel of gooseberries (nellikka) to Mr. Unnithan, accompanied by a sarcastic note suggesting that he perform Nellikkathalam (treatment with gooseberry) three times a day.

facts.claim: The note mocked Mr. Unnithan, claiming that Mr. Parambil’s growing public support had unsettled him
facts.quote: The note mocked Mr. Unnithan, claiming that Mr. Parambil’s growing public support had unsettled him.

facts.claim: Mr. Unnithan’s remarks against Mr. Parambil have triggered resentment among Congress workers
facts.quote: Mr. Unnithan’s remarks against Mr. Parambil have triggered resentment among Congress workers.

facts.claim: What began as a war of words on social media has now spilled over into direct protests
facts.quote: What began as a war of words on social media has now spilled over into direct protests.
